description: The terrain near the water's edge is split into 1 m cells (issue #76): on every course, at points every 3.7 m where the ground is between 7 m deep and 1 m up, a ray down finds the terrain's collision (no holes), and the ground lies within 6 cm of the terrain's own height, where the coarse 4 m grid it replaced was 0.45 to 0.68 m off (shallows_check.gd).
